column1: # ESP32-S3 Custom Partition Table for trmnl (4MB flash)
# NVS is 48KB (0xC000) to fix ESP_ERR_NVS_NOT_ENOUGH_SPACE errors.
# 2026-08-18: Removed the unused `factory` slot and equalized the two OTA slots.
# The previous layout was factory 0x180000 / ota_0 0x180000 / ota_1 0xE0000 (896K).
# ESPHome flashes the app into ota_0
# targeted the undersized ota_1 and was rejected ("OTA partition is too small")
# once firmware grew past 896K. Two equal 1984K slots leave ~2x headroom.
# App partitions must stay aligned to 0x10000.
